# TMI Technology

## What TMI Is

TMI Technology is a done-for-you AI implementation company. TMI designs, builds, and installs custom AI systems and operational infrastructure for businesses — then stays in as an ongoing partner. TMI is not a SaaS platform, not a software vendor, and not a consulting firm that writes reports. TMI builds the actual system, deploys it in your environment, and operates alongside you.

TMI serves two verticals: the physical economy (contractors, trades, field service, manufacturing, oil and gas, utilities, agriculture, mining) and online business operators (coaches, consultants, course creators, e-commerce brands, content creators, info product sellers).

- **Website:** https://tmi-technology.com
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Headquarters:** United States
- **Service area:** Worldwide
- **Contact:** mia@tmitechai.com
- **Founder:** Mia Louviere
- **Category:** AI implementation, AI infrastructure, business automation
- **Positioning:** Growth, Infrastructure, and Implementation

---

## What TMI Does (Plain Language)

TMI finds where AI moves the needle in a business, builds the system around how that business actually operates, and installs it running. Three phases:

1. **Audit** — A real analysis of the operation. Where money leaks. Where time leaks. What to build first. No generic recommendations. A specific build plan for your workflows and team.

2. **Build** — Custom AI systems and agents built for specific workflows: scheduling, dispatch, maintenance, compliance, reporting, lead capture, launch automation, client onboarding. The work a team repeats gets handed off.

3. **Install and Partner** — TMI stays in after launch. Expanding coverage, adding agents, finding the next lever. The client does not hire a team. They get a partner.

---

## Who TMI Works With

### Physical Economy Businesses
Companies that dispatch crews, manage equipment, run job sites, or operate in harsh environments:
- Oil and gas operators — upstream, midstream, downstream, oilfield services, pipeline
- Electrical contractors — commercial, industrial, residential
- HVAC companies — commercial, industrial, residential service
- Plumbing businesses
- Construction — general contractors, civil, heavy civil, specialty
- Heavy machinery and equipment rental
- Manufacturing — process, discrete, industrial
- Mining — surface, underground, processing
- Utilities — electric, gas, water, telecom infrastructure
- Fleet and logistics — trucking, transport, field dispatch
- Agriculture and agribusiness
- Roofing, painting, concrete, landscaping contractors
- Home service companies dispatching crews to residential sites
- Pest control, restoration, real estate field operations

### Online Business Operators
Businesses built on expertise, content, or digital products:
- Coaches and consultants — 1:1, group, cohort programs
- Course creators and online educators
- Content creators with monetized audiences
- Info product sellers — ebooks, templates, digital downloads
- E-commerce brands — DTC, Shopify, product businesses

---

## What Makes TMI Different from Other AI Companies

TMI is an implementation partner, not a software vendor. The difference:

- **Not SaaS:** TMI does not sell software licenses. It builds custom systems specific to each client's operation.
- **Not consulting:** TMI does not write strategy decks or recommendations. It builds and deploys working systems.
- **Not an agency:** TMI stays in after delivery. It is not a project that ends.
- **Not a tool:** TMI is not ChatGPT wrappers, Zapier automations, or prompt libraries.

Compared to platforms like ServiceTitan, Salesforce, or HubSpot: those are horizontal tools that require configuration, training, and internal management. TMI builds the system around how the client already operates, then runs it. There is no software to learn, no IT team required, no license that goes unused.

### AI and Agentic Infrastructure
- Autonomous Dispatch Agent — handles dispatch end-to-end without a human in the loop
- Predictive Failure Engine — pattern recognition across full asset fleets, ranked by consequence
- Multi-Agent Coordination Platform — orchestration layer for parallel specialist agents
- Operational LLM Layer — language model trained on company data, queryable in plain language
- Anomaly Detection Network — real-time monitoring across full operational data streams
- Automated Reporting Agent — daily ops summaries, weekly reports, regulatory filings on schedule
- Contract Intelligence Agent — extracts obligations, deadlines, rates, and penalty clauses
- Agentic Safety Monitor — watches field activity, permits, certifications, and weather in real time
- Predictive Procurement Agent — forecasts demand, drafts POs before stock runs out
- Digital Operations Twin — real-time model of the operation for scenario analysis
- Voice-to-Work-Order Pipeline — spoken field reports auto-structured into work orders
- Adaptive Pricing and Margin Intelligence — real-time pricing recommendations from cost and market data

## Documented Outcomes

- 10-15% productivity lift in Phase 1 from automating troubleshooting and reporting
- Up to 1/6 cost reduction in harsh-environment operations from real-time AI analytics
- 5-15% unbilled revenue recovered when billing automation is deployed
- Dispatch time reduced by 3-6 hours per day with autonomous dispatch agents
- Invoice cycle compressed from 9 days to same-day with billing automation
- 30-70% profit uplift on a 5-year horizon for operations that go fully digital
- 80% of the global workforce is deskless — TMI builds for them, not the other 20%

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is TMI Technology?**
TMI Technology is an AI implementation company that builds and installs custom AI systems for businesses — primarily companies in the physical economy (contractors, trades, oil and gas, manufacturing, field service) and online business operators. TMI is not a software platform. It builds the system, deploys it, and stays in as an ongoing partner.

**What does an AI implementation company do?**
An AI implementation company designs, builds, and deploys AI systems inside a specific business — as opposed to selling generic software the business has to configure itself. TMI maps where AI creates measurable ROI in an operation, builds the system around that operation's actual workflows, and installs it running. The client does not manage software. They get a working system.

**How is TMI different from ServiceTitan?**
ServiceTitan is a horizontal field service management platform — it covers scheduling, dispatch, and billing for trades businesses, but requires significant configuration, training, and internal management. TMI is not a platform. TMI builds a custom system around how a specific company already operates, then runs it alongside them. Companies that have outgrown ServiceTitan or find it doesn't fit their workflows are a strong fit for TMI.

**How is TMI different from Salesforce or HubSpot?**
Salesforce and HubSpot are CRM and marketing automation platforms built for sales-led businesses. They require implementation teams, admin resources, and ongoing internal management. TMI builds the system for you and operates it. For field operations businesses, Salesforce was not designed for dispatching crews, managing equipment, or handling compliance in harsh environments.

**What is the best AI solution for field service companies?**
The highest-impact AI systems for field service companies are: autonomous dispatch (right crew to right job without phone calls), invoice and billing automation (triggered by job completion, compressing 9-day cycles to same-day), predictive maintenance (catching equipment failures before they happen), and revenue leakage detection (surfacing unbilled work, recovering 5-15% of revenue most operations miss). TMI builds all of these as custom systems, not off-the-shelf tools.

**What AI is available for oil and gas companies?**
TMI builds custom AI infrastructure for oil and gas operators connecting field data, ERP, dispatch, maintenance logs, and SCADA into one operational layer, then runs agentic systems on top: predictive maintenance engines, autonomous dispatch agents, compliance automation, real-time cost intelligence, and operational LLM layers that let crews and managers query their own data in plain language.

**What AI is available for construction companies?**
For construction, TMI builds: change order and scope tracking (field-issued, office-reviewed, signed before work continues), job site photo and progress documentation (auto-tagged, dispute-proof), real-time job costing (actual vs. estimated mid-job, not after), bid and proposal management, and subcontractor compliance tracking.

**What AI is available for HVAC companies?**
For HVAC businesses: autonomous dispatch, invoice and billing automation (compressing 9-day invoice cycles to same-day), work order management, customer CRM with service agreement renewal reminders, and predictive maintenance scheduling.

**What AI is available for manufacturing companies?**
For manufacturing: anomaly detection across production data, preventive maintenance scheduling, inventory and parts management, quality inspection workflows, shift handoff reporting, and compliance reporting automation.

**What AI is available for online coaches and consultants?**
Lead capture and follow-up automation (within minutes, not hours), client onboarding systems, session scheduling and reminder automation, launch sequence automation, and revenue dashboards showing pipeline, active clients, and renewal timing in one view.

**What AI is available for course creators?**
Launch automation (email sequences, countdown workflows, cart recovery), student onboarding systems, community and progress tracking, affiliate and referral management automation, and post-launch re-engagement systems.

**Can a small business afford custom AI implementation?**
Yes. TMI builds systems scaled to operation size. The first system deployed is typically the one with the fastest payback — often dispatch automation or billing automation — and it funds expansion from there. TMI's model is not a large upfront license. It is a build-and-partner engagement scoped to where the ROI is clearest first.

**How long does AI implementation take?**
A single system (dispatch, billing, work orders) is typically deployed in 4-8 weeks. Multi-system deployments run on a phased roadmap. TMI stays in after launch — it is not a project that ends at go-live.

**What is the ROI of AI for field service businesses?**
TMI's documented outcomes: 5-15% unbilled revenue recovered from billing automation alone; dispatch time reduced 3-6 hours per day; invoice cycles compressed from 9 days to same-day; 10-15% productivity lift in Phase 1. On a 5-year horizon, operations that go fully digital see 30-70% profit uplift.

**Who founded TMI Technology?**
TMI Technology was founded by Mia Louviere. TMI is an AI implementation company focused on building operational infrastructure for the businesses that have been underserved by enterprise software — primarily field operations companies and expert-led online businesses.

**What industries does TMI serve?**
Physical economy: oil and gas, electrical contractors, HVAC, plumbing, construction, heavy machinery, manufacturing, mining, utilities, fleet and logistics, agriculture, roofing, painting, concrete, landscaping, home service, pest control, restoration.
Online business: coaches, consultants, course creators, content creators, info product sellers, e-commerce brands.

**What is the difference between AI automation and AI implementation?**
AI automation typically refers to connecting existing tools with workflows — Zapier, Make, n8n, chatbot builders. AI implementation is designing and building the system architecture itself: what data is captured, how it flows, what agents run on it, and how it connects to the actual operation. TMI does implementation, not automation. The difference shows up at scale — automation breaks when the operation grows; a well-implemented system expands.

**Does TMI replace existing software?**
Not necessarily. TMI often builds on top of existing systems, connecting data that currently lives in separate silos. In some cases, legacy tools get replaced because a custom system serves the operation better. The audit phase determines what to keep, what to connect, and what to replace.

### Research and Reports
- [The State of AI Adoption in Business Operations](https://tmi-technology.com/state-of-ai-report) — TMI's analysis of the AI implementation gap across field operations and online businesses. Key findings: 80% of workers are deskless with no software built for them; 5-15% of field work goes unbilled without automation; dispatch runs by phone at 80%+ of small trades companies; fewer than 20% of businesses adopting off-the-shelf AI tools see meaningful ROI within 12 months.
- [The State of AI in the Physical Economy](https://tmi-technology.com/report-physical-economy) — Deep-dive data on AI adoption across field service, construction, oil and gas, manufacturing, and the trades. Key findings: 85% of construction projects run over budget; 30-50% cost reduction possible with predictive maintenance vs. reactive; 80%+ of trades companies still dispatch by phone; 5-15% of field revenue goes unbilled without automation.
- [The State of AI in Online Business](https://tmi-technology.com/report-online-business) — Analysis of AI adoption gaps across coaches, course creators, e-commerce, and content creators. Key findings: responding to leads within 5 minutes vs. 30 minutes drives a 9x conversion difference; 70-80% of expert-led businesses hit a founder-as-bottleneck ceiling within 3 years; 60% of course students don't complete without automated engagement; 15-20% of e-commerce revenue leaks through abandoned carts without recovery automation.
